A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
quantum mechanics is a theory about the behavior of quantum particles, and not about waves.
the wave function is the most convenient way to describe the quantum state of a system, but that the quantum state of the system is not the wave function.
the quantum interference effect is the result of an interaction between the quantum particle and the environment, and the quantum interference effect can be switched on and off by the environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the wave function is a tool to predict the outcome of experiments, and it is not a physical entity that exists independently of the measuring apparatus.
filtering devices do not act on the quantum particles directly but on the Wigner distribution functions of the particles.
